title: The Clockinator Lite WordPress plugin before 1.1.0 does not check authorisation or ownership when updating leave…
description: The Clockinator Lite WordPress plugin versions before 1.1.0 have a vulnerability where the plugin does not verify authorization or ownership when updating leave requests. This flaw allows unauthenticated users to modify any leave record, including approving, rejecting, or reassigning leave requests to other users.
